name: Crude Charge Heater
description: Horizontal-tube cabin heater, balanced draft (FD + ID fans) with regenerative air preheater, floor-fired, 4-pass process coil (convection then radiant)
key_design_data: Absorbed 35 MW; fired 38.5 MW LHV; eta ~91% LHV; 50,000 bbl/d ANS 250->360 C

name: Radiant Section
description: Refractory-lined cabin firebox; tubes horizontal along side walls; bridgewall TCs at radiant exit
key_design_data: Radiant duty ~26 MW (74%); bridgewall ~845 C (envelope 760-900 C); arch draft -2.5 mmH2O

name: Radiant Coil
description: 4 passes x 20 tubes, 6in Sch 40 (OD 168.3 mm, wall 7.11 mm), ASTM A335 P9, 18.3 m effective length
key_design_data: Area ~766 m2; avg flux ~34 kW/m2; peak/avg ~1.8; TMT limit 600 C; 2 skin TCs per pass

name: Convection Section
description: 2 bare shield rows + 6 studded rows, process coil (4 passes), steam soot blowers

name: Process Burners (8)
description: Forced-draft low-NOx gas burners, floor-mounted in one row, common hot-air windbox (registers set at tuning)
key_design_data: 4.8 MW normal / 5.8 MW design (120%) each; fuel-gas pressure 1.2 barg; hot air ~300 C

name: Fuel Gas Knock-Out Drum
description: Vertical drum upstream of fuel-gas control valve; removes liquids/condensate; level trip
key_design_data: Design 6 barg / 120 C; LSHH trips heater

name: Fuel Gas System
description: Refinery fuel gas header, KO drum, PCV, main and pilot shutoff valves, burner manifold
key_design_data: 2,860 kg/h normal (~3,800 Nm3/h), LHV 48.5 MJ/kg

name: Pilot Gas System
description: Separate regulated pilot gas supply to continuous pilots on each burner
key_design_data: Pilot pressure 0.7 barg

name: Stack
description: Self-supporting steel stack after ID fan; also serves natural-draft bypass path
key_design_data: Flue to stack ~155 C (ID discharge); ~400 C on bypass

name: Flue-Gas Bypass Damper
description: Damper from convection outlet direct to stack, bypassing APH and ID fan; closed in balanced-draft operation (XV-1361)
key_design_data: Fails open; opens on FD/ID fan or APH rotor stop

name: Emergency Air Doors
description: Doors on burner windbox admitting ambient air for natural-draft operation (XV-1362)
key_design_data: Fail open; natural-draft capability ~60% firing

name: Regenerative Air Preheater
description: Rotary regenerative (Ljungstrom) APH, vertical shaft; heats combustion air with flue gas leaving the convection section; cold-air bypass TV-1345; steam soot blowers SB-102A/B
key_design_data: Duty ~4.3 MW; flue 390 -> 160 C; air 30 -> ~300 C; seal leakage ~6% of air as new

name: Forced Draft Fan
description: Centrifugal fan with VFD (SC-1341) delivering combustion air through APH to burner windbox
key_design_data: 57,850 kg/h; ~1.5 kPa; ~30 kW absorbed; 75 kW motor

name: Induced Draft Fan
description: Centrifugal fan with VFD (SC-1351) drawing flue gas through APH; controls arch draft
key_design_data: 60,700 kg/h at ~150 C; ~1.3 kPa; ~40 kW absorbed; 90 kW motor

name: Flue Gas Analyzers
description: Arch O2 (extractive, dry basis) and CO; stack CEMS O2 and NOx
key_design_data: O2 normal 3.0% dry; CO < 50 ppm

name: Pass Flow Control Station
description: Four pass flow control valves with SIS low-flow transmitters; manual pass balancing on outlet temperature
key_design_data: 71.5 t/h per pass

name: Transfer Line
description: Combined coil outlet header to atmospheric column flash zone
key_design_data: ~2.5 barg, 360 C, two-phase

name: Snuffing / Purge Steam
description: LP steam to firebox and header boxes for fire extinguishing and pre-light-off purge
key_design_data: LP steam 3.5 barg

name: Convection Soot Blowers (6)
description: Retractable steam soot blowers in studded convection rows (SB-101A-F) plus APH blowers SB-102A/B, sequenced
key_design_data: LP steam 3.5 barg; typical one sequence per day

name: Burner Management System / SIS
description: SIL-rated logic: fuel trips, pass low-flow trip, firebox high pressure, fan/APH-stop natural-draft runback, purge permissive, flame supervision
key_design_data: See ctrl_alarm_trip_register and safe_bms_cause_and_effect

name: Crude Charge Pumps (boundary)
description: Upstream of the preheat train; deliver crude to heater inlet header (boundary equipment)
key_design_data: Heater inlet header ~11 barg

name: Atmospheric Crude Column (boundary)
description: Receives heater effluent in flash zone (boundary equipment)
key_design_data: Flash zone ~1.5 barg
